user.title: Vigicrues Configuration
user.description: Enter the station IDs or URLs you want to monitor (comma-separated). You can also leave empty and add stations later. You can copy the URL from https://www.vigicrues.gouv.fr/

data_description.stations: List of station IDs or URLs separated by commas. Leave empty to configure later. Example: {stations_example}

add_station.title: Add a station
add_station.description: Add a station to the existing list without replacing the others.

remove_stations.title: Remove stations
remove_stations.description: Select stations to remove from the integration.

set_scan_interval.title: Update interval
set_scan_interval.description: Choose how often station data is refreshed.

error.no_stations_selected: Select at least one station to remove
